system.description:
Level 1.

You possess four Gates, each summoning a different Spirit Beast. Summon a Spirit Beast into an unoccupied space within 3 spaces as a 2 Stamina Swift Action, or sacrifice a Rank 4 component to ignore the Stamina cost. All Spirit Beast Abilities are Swift Actions costing you 1 Stamina. The first time a Spirit uses its Primary or Defense Ability it has no Stamina cost. You may only have one Spirit in combat at a time — summoning a second sends the first back through its Gate.

Spirit Beasts use your Resistances and gain +3 when rolling to Resist [Magykal] abilities.

  • Crimson Gate — Beast of Destruction
  • Violet Gate — Beast of Protection
  • Azure Gate — Beast of Freedom
  • Sage Gate — Beast of Solace
